title: Retro Future
description:
My team's third-year final project was an overly-ambitious multiplayer first-person shooter called Retro Future. I don't have the source code any more, but I do still have this massive **poster** that was printed for us!

![](/assets/projects/college/retro-future/screenshot-2.jpg)You can see the tower I modelled as our only level, and we had begun to use Unity networking to build multiplayer sessions, but unsurprisingly we did not come anywhere near a finished FPS!
